sections.title: 1. Data Controller Identification
sections.content:

sections.title: 2. Types of Personal Data We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following types of personal data:

• Full name
• Phone number
• Email address
• Appointment data (date, time, requested service)
• WhatsApp communication history
• Payment information (processed by third parties)
• Location data (only if voluntarily provided)

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.content:
We use your personal data for the following purposes:

• Appointment management: Process and confirm your booking requests.
• WhatsApp communication: Send appointment reminders, confirmations, and service updates.
• Customer support: Respond to your inquiries and provide technical assistance.
• Marketing (only with your consent): Send promotions, news, and relevant content from TU_NEGOCIO.
• Billing and collections: Process service payments.
• Legal compliance: Maintain records according to Paraguayan legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.content:
The processing of your data is carried out under the following legal bases:

• Consent: When you voluntarily provide your data and accept this policy.
• Contract execution: For the management of services requested by you.
• Legitimate interest: To improve our services and communicate important updates.
• Legal obligations: To comply with applicable Paraguayan laws.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention Period
sections.content:
We retain your personal data for the following periods:

• Client data: 5 years after the last interaction.
• Appointment records: 3 years for accounting and tax compliance.
• WhatsApp communications: 2 years from the last conversation.
• Marketing data (if applicable): Until you revoke your consent.

Once the retention period expires, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights (Data Subject Rights)
sections.content:
You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

• Access: Request a copy of all your personal data we have.
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data (when legally possible).
• Objection: Object to the processing of your data for direct marketing.
• Restriction: Request that we limit the use of your data in certain circumstances.
• Portability: Receive your data in a structured, readable format.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at contacto@tu-emprendimiento.com. We will respond to your request within 30 business days.

sections.title: 7. Sharing Data with Third Parties
sections.content:
We do not sell or rent your personal data. We share information only in the following cases:

• WhatsApp/Meta: For WhatsApp communication, your data (phone number, messages) is processed by Meta under their Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy/

• Payment processors: We share payment data with processors like Bancard, Pagopar, or Tigo Money to manage transactions. These processors have their own privacy policies.

• Hosting and technology services: We store data on secure servers for website operation.

• Legal requirements: We may disclose data if required by law, such as a court order.

sections.title: 8. Security Measures
sections.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration:

• Data encryption in transit and at rest
• Restricted access to authorized personnel only
• Regular system monitoring
• Secure data retention policies

However, no Internet transmission is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security for your data.

sections.title: 9. Use of Cookies
sections.content:
Our website uses cookies to:

• Improve user experience
• Analyze site traffic
• Personalize content

You can configure your browser to reject cookies. This may affect some website functionality.

sections.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "last updated" date.

We recommend reviewing this policy regularly to stay informed about how we protect your data.

sections.title: 11. Contact for Data Protection
sections.content:
If you have questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, contact us:

Tu Emprendimiento (TU_NEGOCIO)
Email: contacto@tu-emprendimiento.com
Phone: +595 981 000 000
Address: TU_CIUDAD, Paraguay

For personal data inquiries, we will respond within 30 business days.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing and using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and expressly accepted these Terms and Conditions in full. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
sections.body:
Tu Emprendimiento provides consulting and development services for technology solutions for businesses and entrepreneurs. Our services include, among others: web and application development, artificial intelligence consulting, process automation, and digital transformation solutions.

The specific service contracted will be detailed in the corresponding commercial proposal or contract.

sections.title: 3. Booking and Cancellation Policy
sections.body:
Bookings: To confirm an appointment or service, the client must make payment in advance.

Cancellations: The client may cancel their appointment up to 24 hours before the scheduled time at no cost.

Late cancellations: Cancellations made with less than 24 hours notice will result in the full loss of the amount paid, as the reserved time cannot be recovered.

No-shows: In case of failure to attend the scheduled appointment without prior notice, 100% of the service cost will be applied as a penalty.

Exceptions: In exceptional circumstances (medical emergencies, natural disasters), we will evaluate each case individually.

sections.title: 4. Payment Terms
sections.body:
Payment methods: We accept bank transfers, credit/debit card payments, and digital wallets.

Payment deadlines: Payment must be made in full before the start of any service, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Invoicing: We issue legal invoices in accordance with current Paraguayan regulations. Please provide your tax information correctly at the time of contracting.

Delinquency: In case of non-payment, Tu Emprendimiento reserves the right to suspend services until the debt is regularized.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
Tu Emprendimiento shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.

Our maximum liability shall in no case exceed the total amount actually paid by the client for the specific service that gave rise to the claim.

We do not guarantee specific results beyond what is expressly agreed upon in the service contract.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body:
Source code, designs, documentation, and any material developed specifically for the client shall be their property after full payment of the services, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Tu Emprendimiento retains the right to use generic techniques, tools, and knowledge acquired during the provision of services for other projects.

Trademarks, logos, and copyrighted materials of third parties are the property of their respective owners.

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Paraguay.

Any dispute arising from the interpretation or execution of these terms shall be resolved exclusively before the competent courts of the City of TU_CIUDAD, Paraguay, with express waiver of any other jurisdiction.
